content: Given that your friend has three shirts in shades of red (red, maroon, and burgundy), he might appreciate a gift that complements his existing collection. Among the options you provided—crimson, white, or blue—crimson is the closest in color to the shades he already has. Therefore, crimson could be a great choice. However, if you're looking for a more neutral or versatile option, white could also be a good gift. Blue would be a departure from the red palette, but if he likes blue, it could still be a great option. Ultimately, consider his personal style and preferences when choosing!
